Permit Handbook

This handbook explains how the Office issues and renews operating permits for small vessels.

Applying for a permit

An applicant submits Form P-1 with proof of ownership and a current safety inspection report.

Required documents

  • Proof of ownership, such as a bill of sale or registration certificate.
  • A safety inspection report dated within the last twelve months.

Note:

Copies are accepted only when they are certified by a notary public.

Fees and payment

The application fee is 120 dollars and is payable by card or by bank transfer to the Office.

Renewing
a permit

A permit is renewed every three years; the Office sends a reminder ninety days before expiry.

Appeals

An applicant may appeal a refusal to the Review Board within thirty days of the decision.
